# Search quality — 14 days to 2026-09-18

*2026-09-04 05:33:45 to 2026-09-18 05:33:45*

Search handled 152 searches this period at a health score of 68.9/100. That is up 3.7 points on the previous period. 24 queries are failing badly enough to need attention, and 10 of the flagged terms are products the catalogue stocks but search did not surface.

## What changed

| Metric | Previous | This period | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Health score | 65.2 | 68.9 | +3.7 (better) |
| Searches | 148 | 152 | +4 |
| Failing queries | 23 | 24 | +1 (worse) |
| Zero-result rate | 6.8% | 9.2% | +2.5 pp (worse) |
| Irrelevant-result rate | 18.2% | 13.2% | -5.1 pp (better) |
| Under-filled rate | 30.4% | 39.5% | +9.1 pp (worse) |
| Retrieval gaps | 10 | 10 | +0 |

## Searches that came back empty

9.2% of searches returned nothing at all.

| Query | Searches | Empty | Catalogue | Cause |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| “kombucha” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “quinoa” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “truffle” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “زعفران” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “wasabi” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “كافيار” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “كينوا” | 2 | 2 | not stocked | assortment gap |

## What needs attention

**1. “دجاج”** — 11 searches, severity 0.37
- Only 4.5 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 100% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**2. “juice”** — 6 searches, severity 0.46
- Only 2.3 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 40% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**3. “شاي”** — 5 searches, severity 0.43
- Only 3.4 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 50% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**4. “عصير”** — 6 searches, severity 0.36
- Only 3.7 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 60% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 75% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**5. “straw”** — 2 searches, severity 0.94
- 100% of searches returned nothing that mentions the query.
- Only 1.5 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 100% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.
- No product in the catalogue uses this word or anything close to it, so this may be an assortment gap rather than a search fault.

## Awaiting review

34 proposals are pending (8 misspelling, 1 partial query, 25 synonym). Strongest first:

- `chicken` → `دجاج` (synonym, confidence 0.84)
- `milk` → `حليب` (synonym, confidence 0.84)
- `فاراوله` → `فراوله` (misspelling, confidence 0.80)
- `فراولت` → `فراوله` (misspelling, confidence 0.80)
- `chiken` → `chicken` (misspelling, confidence 0.78)

None of these are applied until a reviewer approves and exports them.

## How to read these numbers

- No click or order data exists in this dataset, so engagement is inferred from whether shoppers searched again. Searches that ended a session are excluded rather than assumed successful.
- 3% of searches were re-fired within two seconds with identical results and look automated rather than human; they are excluded from the engagement figures.
